channel_convention: Teams post to the Vegas Teams/Photos channel, tag Dawn Dearstone, include Team number and Quest number in the message.
scoring_note: Base quest points only. Dawn's creativity bonuses (0-10 on eligible quests), Power (host-scored), and Fortune (self-reported paper) are NOT scored by this system. Bonus candidates are surfaced for Dawn's review, never auto-scored.

1.title: Creative Group Photo
vision_criteria: Story sequence of 3-4 connected shots (multiple images in one post)
Background should use the Viva Vision canopy or Vegas Vic
Creative posing and positioning
Team visible in the shots

3.title: Acting It Out
vision_criteria: Video (~15 sec) of the team performing a routine with a street performer
The street performer and the team are visible together

4.title: Go for the Gold (Golden Nugget)
items: The Hand of Faith (world's largest gold nugget on display)
The giant golden hand sign
The shark tank at The Tank pool
A Golden Nugget-branded poker chip or playing card
An AI-enabled bar
Bevo and the Houston Rodeo memorabilia
A selfie with a Golden Nugget staff member, preferably cowgirl (with their permission)
Our CEO's favorite bar with an awesome water view
vision_criteria: Team in each item photo, staying together
Photos shared AS ONE POST

5.title: Slomo Scenes
vision_criteria: Video (~10 sec) of a synchronized group walk (slow-motion, runway strut, or spy squad)
Everyone commits to the bit
Viva Vision canopy makes an excellent backdrop

6.title: Let's Eat!
vision_criteria: Classic downtown Vegas food item (e.g., shrimp cocktail, something deep-fried)
Food critic video review with team members sampling and rating the item

7.title: Landmarks
items: Viva Vision canopy (synchronized light show poses)
Vegas Vic (cowboy tableau)
SlotZilla (superhero flight poses; bonus timing if a zipliner is overhead)
Golden Nugget shark tank (swim poses)
vision_criteria: Video at each landmark reenacting a scene or pose inspired by it
Team visible and committing to the scene

8.title: Horseshoe History (Binion's)
items: Team photo with the $1,000,000 cash display
A World Series of Poker reference
A photo of Benny Binion himself (statue or portrait)
Vintage casino carpet
A single-deck blackjack table
A roulette scoreboard with 2 '00' on it
Your favorite haunted encounter
Group photo with Apache
vision_criteria: Team in each item photo, staying together
Photos shared AS ONE POST

9.title: Vintage Vegas (Fremont Street)
items: Vegas Vickie, the famous kicking neon cowgirl (inside Circa)
The longest bar in Nevada (Mega Bar)
Las Vegas's first telephone (phone number 1)
The 'oldest casino' plaque (est. 1906)
A $5-or-less table game sign
A vintage slot machine
A neon sign with an arrow
Dice-themed decor
vision_criteria: Team in each item photo, staying together
Photos shared AS ONE POST

10.title: Human Slot Machine
vision_criteria: Video of the team in a row acting as slot machine reels: spin then freeze in poses
Extra style for doing it in front of a real slot bank (bonus-relevant, not base score)

11.title: High Five
vision_criteria: Video (max 3 min) of 2 team members high-fiving as many people as possible
Participants (non-team members) visible being high-fived

12.title: Selfie Confessions
vision_criteria: Video where each team member takes a turn with the phone answering 'craziest thing you've ever done in a meeting'
Singular continuous video (member hand-offs visible)

13.title: Zip Bomber
vision_criteria: Video from beneath the SlotZilla zipline flight path catching a rider overhead
Whole team reacting like it's a UFO sighting, committing to the bit

14.title: Zoltar Speaks
items: Zoltar fortune from a Zoltar machine (at least 2 members at 2 different machines)
vision_criteria: Fortunes posted along with a team pic in front of the Zoltar(s) used
Base score counts the first 2 Zoltars; additional machines are Dawn's bonus territory

15.title: Neon Alphabet
vision_criteria: Team name spelled out in letters from Fremont Street neon signs, one letter per photo
All letters shared AS ONE POST

16.title: Elvis Has Entered the Building
vision_criteria: Team photo with one of Fremont's street Elvises (an Elvis impersonator must be visible)
